description.content: Get step-by-step evaluation of permissions for a user attempting a specific operation on a resource, showing which policies were evaluated and why the decision was made. Only admins can debug other users' permission evaluations.

query.description: (Required) Name of the user to evaluate permissions for
(Required) Type of resource (e.g., table, database, pipeline)
UUID or Fully Qualified Name (FQN) of the specific resource instance (optional)
(Required) Operation to check (e.g., VIEW_ALL, EDIT_ALL, DELETE)
